newsitem.title: USA: Cairn Energy hires DLJ as adviser.
newsitem.headline: Cairn Energy hires DLJ as adviser.

text.p: Cairn Energy USA Inc Monday said it retained the investment banking firm of Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette to assist it in the exploration of strategic alternatives.

The company also said its senior vice president/treasurer, J. Munro Sutherland, is leaving the company and A. Allen Paul, vice president - marketing and administration, is assuming the responsibility of senior vice president - finance/treasurer on an interim basis. The company plans to retain a search firm to find a successor to Sutherland.
A company spokesman said nothing specific prompted Cairn's hiring of an adviser and declined to comment on the reason for Sutherland's departure other than to say the company wishes him well.
The company is engaged in exploration for and the development and production of crude oil and natural gas, principally in the Outer Continental Shelf of the Gulf of Mexico.
